:::{#thm-time-hierarchy-general}
#### The time hierarchy theorem

Let $f$ and $g$ be [time-constructible functions](models-of-computation.qmd#def-time-constructible)
with $f(n) \log_2 f(n) = o(g(n))$
([little-o notation](asymptotic-notation.qmd#def-little-o)).
Then the [time complexity class](#def-dtime) $\text{DTIME}(f(n))$
is a proper subset of $\text{DTIME}(g(n))$
[@arora2009computational, section 3.1].

:::
